name: Research Library audiences
note: Each audience reorders the same Research Library shelves and names the funder shelf entries that fit it. Full names, no acronyms. Individuals never register; everything public is theirs. Roles reconstructed from Verdant Equanim documents on 2026-11-08; to be reconciled with the stakeholder list once it is written down once.

audiences.label: County or regional grant writer
audiences.one_line: Pull the county's rank on a measure and the citation behind it for a needs statement in one motion, then open the funder shelf.

audiences.label: Critical access hospital, rural health clinic or hospital administrator
audiences.one_line: The community health needs assessment every three years, and a number you can defend to the board with the County Health Rankings methods paper.

audiences.label: Certified community behavioral health clinic or behavioral health provider
audiences.one_line: Keep the required community needs assessment current and see where referral demand will come from.

audiences.label: Local health department
audiences.one_line: Where the public sources agree, and which measures the county leads the state on.

audiences.label: Behavioral Health Region
audiences.one_line: Roll the county view up to the region's boundary.

audiences.label: Kindergarten through grade 12 school or Educational Service Unit
audiences.one_line: Which early life experiences the county's adults report most, and what the evidence says about each.

audiences.label: College or university
audiences.one_line: Teaching the difference between a finding and a headline, and student research with county data.

audiences.label: Tribal Nation
audiences.one_line: The Nation decides what is shown about its people and to whom. Survey layers for tribal respondents follow the Nation's own data agreements, not only the Verdant Equanim board.
audiences.review_note: This row is reviewed with the Ponca Tribe of Nebraska contact, or a reviewer the Nation names, before anything beyond the shelf order is published.

audiences.label: Nebraska Extension office
audiences.one_line: County fair and community event survey collection, and local program evidence.

audiences.label: Faith community, community organization or nonprofit
audiences.one_line: Where loneliness and low support concentrate, and where confidence in finding help is low.

audiences.label: Farm and agriculture organization
audiences.one_line: Financial stress, sleep and substance use in farm counties.

audiences.label: County board, city council, mayor or other elected official
audiences.one_line: Where this county stands, on one page: the county card and three or four sources.

audiences.label: Foundation or philanthropic funder
audiences.one_line: Where to put the next dollar, by measured need, and which graded interventions a county does not yet have.

audiences.label: State agency or policymaker
audiences.one_line: The statewide picture, the data vintages, and how the numbers are made.

audiences.label: Researcher or data analyst
audiences.one_line: The full library, the inclusion standard, reliability by subscale, and the open items: what was left out and why.

audiences.label: Insurer, actuary or risk team
audiences.one_line: An upstream signal layer. Approved uses only; never individual underwriting.

audiences.label: Employer
audiences.one_line: Improving the work environment. Never screening employees.

audiences.label: Individual or family
audiences.one_line: Everything here is yours, no code needed: your county's page, the research, what works, and what the people with responsibility in your county are doing about it.
